row.evidence: Kyriba publishes no SCIM endpoint: its developer portal lists 44 REST APIs including a Users API to "create, read, update, and delete users", and Okta provisioning exists only through a connector "built and is maintained by Aquera".
row.notes: Quote-only treasury platform with no public pricing page (kyriba.com/pricing is a 404). None by absence: no SCIM in the developer portal (llms.txt and all 44 API skill files), and the help centre (community.kyriba.com) is login-only. Okta lists a Kyriba SWA app and a third-party 'Kyriba By Aquera' SCIM connector (Create, Update), which does not change status. Kyriba's own REST Users API (OAuth2 client credentials) can create, update and permanently delete users and manage user-group membership; no IdP connector by Kyriba was found.

endpoints.purpose: List audit trail entries for an entity

audit_log_api.notes: Entity change-history (audit trail) API, not a sign-in log.

rate_limits.text: 50 calls per 30 seconds, one active request at a time; daily quota shared per customer environment.

limitations.text: DELETE permanently removes the user and all associated settings.

okta.notes: Two OIN entries: 'Kyriba' (SWA only) and 'Kyriba By Aquera' (SCIM, Create and Update checked), built and maintained by Aquera.

entra.notes: No Kyriba tutorial in the Microsoft Learn SaaS app index.

open_questions: Kyriba's SSO support and plan are not documented publicly (Okta lists only an SWA app).
Whether the Users API is included with every subscription is not stated.
Whether deactivating (active=false) via PUT frees a licence is not documented.
The help centre is login-only, so a private SCIM guide cannot be ruled out.
